headline.en: Keep remote agent work on your own box.
headline.zh: 让远程 Agent 在自己的计算节点上工作。

sub.en: Airtap connects a thin client to airtapd over mutual TLS. The daemon runs the model and tool loop against the work directory you configure.
sub.zh: Airtap 通过双向 TLS 连接客户端与 airtapd。守护进程按配置调用模型，并在指定工作目录执行工具循环。

body.en: Model, workdir, tools and egress are defined together.
body.zh: 模型、工作目录、工具和出口在同一处定义。

body.en: The client and daemon communicate over mTLS.
body.zh: 客户端与守护进程通过 mTLS 通信。

body.en: The configured dialer records allowed and denied attempts.
body.zh: 已配置拨号器记录允许和拒绝的尝试。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The included example validates examples/airtap.yaml and compares a local model address with an unlisted address without dialing either.
note.zh: 随仓示例校验 examples/airtap.yaml，并比较本地模型地址与未列出的地址，不实际拨号。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Offline manifest validation and allowlist membership; no daemon, model call, or network isolation is exercised.
steps.output:
manifest: valid; model=deepseek-v3; tools=[read write list bash]
127.0.0.1:8000 allowed=true
example.com:443 allowed=false

body.en: The included example validates examples/airtap.yaml and compares a local model address with an unlisted address without dialing either.
body.zh: 随仓示例校验 examples/airtap.yaml，并比较本地模型地址与未列出的地址，不实际拨号。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/airtap.git
cd airtap
go build ./cmd/airtap
go build ./cmd/airtapd

limitations.en: The offline demo checks configuration and policy membership only. It does not start a daemon, call a model, or validate Linux isolation.
limitations.zh: 离线示例只检查配置和策略匹配，不启动守护进程、不调用模型，也不验证 Linux 隔离。

limitations.en: Bash execution requires Linux network namespace support and suitable privileges; it fails closed when isolation cannot be created.
limitations.zh: Bash 执行需要 Linux 网络命名空间及相应权限；无法创建隔离时会拒绝执行。

limitations.en: The dialer governs traffic routed through it; this is not a compliance certification or a firewall for unrelated processes.
limitations.zh: 拨号器管理经过它的流量，不构成合规认证，也不是无关进程的系统防火墙。

body.en: A remote development box needs a clear contract for its model endpoint, permitted tools and outbound destinations. A shared YAML manifest keeps these settings together and makes egress decisions inspectable.
body.zh: 远程开发节点需要明确模型端点、工具集合和允许访问的地址。一份共享 YAML 把这些设置集中起来，出口决策也能从日志检查。

body.en: The client loads the manifest and opens the mTLS tunnel. airtapd dispatches the configured tools and sends model requests through the egress dialer. The dialer checks host:port membership and records allowed and denied attempts. Bash isolation uses Linux network namespaces.
body.zh: 客户端读取配置并建立 mTLS 隧道；airtapd 分发已配置工具，模型请求经过出口拨号器。拨号器按 host:port 检查允许列表，记录允许和拒绝的尝试。Bash 隔离依赖 Linux 网络命名空间。

body.en: The client loads the manifest and opens the mTLS tunnel. airtapd dispatches the configured tools and sends model requests through the egress dialer. The dialer checks host:port membership and records allowed and denied attempts. Bash isolation uses Linux network namespaces.
body.zh: 客户端读取配置并建立 mTLS 隧道；airtapd 分发已配置工具，模型请求经过出口拨号器。拨号器按 host:port 检查允许列表，记录允许和拒绝的尝试。Bash 隔离依赖 Linux 网络命名空间。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: Create the output directory before init. Distribute the manifest and TLS material to the two endpoints, protect ca.key, and set box.addr, model.endpoint, egress.allow and agent.workdir for the actual deployment. agent.max_iterations accepts 0 for the default limit.
body.zh: init 前先创建输出目录。将配置和 TLS 材料部署到两端，妥善保护 ca.key，并根据环境设置 box.addr、model.endpoint、egress.allow 和 agent.workdir。agent.max_iterations 为 0 时采用默认上限。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
mkdir -p local-config
go run ./cmd/airtap init --out ./local-config
go run ./cmd/airtap run --manifest ./airtap.yaml "Inspect this repository"
go run ./cmd/airtap audit --file ./audit.log
